https://robotics-regional.test/rules/202.title: Regional rules v2.1 (effective Nov 1, 2026)
https://robotics-regional.test/rules/202.content:
RULES UPDATE v2.1 (effective Nov 1, 2026). Read the summary of changes first.

SECTION 1: ROBOT SIZE. Unchanged from v2.0. Robot must fit in 28 in x 28 in at the start of a match.

SECTION 2: INTAKE (changed). 2.1 The maximum intake footprint when fully deployed is 12 in x 12 in. In v2.0 the limit was 15 in x 15 in. 2.2 An intake may not extend past the frame perimeter during the starting-zone period. 2.3 New: every intake that deploys must have a passive mechanical stop that limits its travel. A stop that depends on driver judgment does not count. A team that fails 2.3 at inspection must remove that intake for the match.

SECTION 3: MATCH. Match length is 2 min 30 s (unchanged).

SECTION 4: SCORING. A cube in the high goal scores 4 points (was 3 in v2.0). Other scoring is unchanged.

SECTION 5: PIT INSPECTION. Teams present a coach-signed inspection sheet at check-in.

SECTION 6: QUESTIONS. Questions about intake geometry go to the regional office before Nov 10. Answers are posted to this page.
